name: Maruti Infrastructure Limited
about: Maruti Infrastructure Limited engages in the real estate development and construction activities in India. The company develops infrastructure and residential projects, as well as develops and constructs real estate projects. It also provides management property services for residential, commercial, industrial, EWS housing projects, and urban infra projects. It serves commercial and residential sectors. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
